surfaceModel.method: MarchingCubes implicit metaball field over root/trunk/branch skeleton
surfaceModel.purpose: remove segmented-cylinder appearance and create smooth unions at branch/root junctions
surfaceModel.knowledgeBoundary: implicit skin is a rendering/evaluation surface generated from life-state radii; the skeleton/resource graph remains the truth layer

resourceFlow.waterMineralSource: root tip uptake weighted by moisture-direction fit and root growth
resourceFlow.carbonSource: terminal shoot/leaf proxy weighted by light capture after juvenile passes
resourceFlow.allocation: shared budget is divided between Root and Shoot each life pass
resourceFlow.effectOnTopology: bud/root-tip proposals are accepted only while their side of the resource budget remains available

apex.factBasis: shoot apical meristem is a persistent organ-generating zone at shoot tips
apex.renderRule: terminal woody radius tapers continuously; a small meristem-zone marker remains rather than ending in a hard flat cylinder cap
apex.speciesBoundary: visible terminal-bud morphology is not claimed until a Species Score supplies it

rootCore.speciesBoundary: these are reusable root voices, not a claim that every species uses the same root architecture

genericLeaves.role: prove the organ/resource interface and light-source logic
